run_process_mlrs: run the process_mlrs script to process ML relaxation trajectories and group them by adsorbate-surface system
run_anomaly_detection: run anomaly detection on ML relaxation trajectories to detect dissociated adsorbates, desorption, or surface changes
run_min_diff: run the min_diff function to compare atom positions between initial and final structures accounting for periodic boundary conditions
run_parse_args: run parse_args to configure the ML relaxation processing script with trajectory path, output directory, and worker count
run_group_configs: run the script to group ML relaxation configurations by system ID and sort them by lowest energy first
